titulo.alumno: Nuances and expressions: Vocabulary and forms

intro: Work out connotation, register and idiomatic expressions from context. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: Elle rappelle que les titres accrocheurs ne doivent pas toujours être pris au pied de la lettre.
frases.alumno: She reminds readers that eye-catching headlines should not always be taken literally.

frases.estudio: L'expression n'est pas un reproche adressé au public, mais une mise en garde contre les conclusions hâtives.
frases.alumno: The expression is not a reproach to the public, but a warning against hasty conclusions.

piezas.titulo: Reading the vocabulary and the forms
texto: Work out connotation, register and idiomatic expressions from context. Tell apart claims, evidence and reservations; attribute each piece of data to its source before drawing a conclusion.
Watch out: an idiomatic expression can differ from its literal meaning; identify who uses it and with what intention. In this passage, «au pied de la lettre» means «literally».
